sql: WITH RemoteListings AS (SELECT family, COUNT(*) AS open_remote_listings FROM fct_posting WHERE remote_us = TRUE AND is_open = TRUE GROUP BY family), TotalListings AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_open_listings FROM fct_posting WHERE is_open = TRUE) SELECT rl.family, rl.open_remote_listings, CAST(rl.open_remote_listings AS REAL) / tl.total_open_listings AS share FROM RemoteListings rl, TotalListings tl ORDER BY rl.open_remote_listings DESC
